slides.headline: Karnataka Asks Supreme Court to Revive Its Struck-Down 56% Quota

slides.stat_label: Why Karnataka High Court Struck Down the Quota
bullets: SC quota 15% to 17%, ST quota 3% to 7%
Court said the rise breached the 50% ceiling
No prior consultation with national SC, ST commissions
slides.credit_line: Sources: Bar & Bench, The News Minute, PTI, IANS

slides.stat_label: Govt Posts Karnataka Cleared for Hiring in February
bullets: An extra 6% of SC/ST posts held back
They wait on the court's verdict, state says
slides.credit_line: Sources: PTI, IANS, The News Minute

slides.stat_label: Centre Deferred Karnataka's Ninth Schedule Request
bullets: Assembly sought Ninth Schedule cover on 18 Dec 2025
State calls it the only lasting legal safeguard
No Supreme Court hearing date reported yet
slides.credit_line: Sources: PTI, IANS, The News Minute
